## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `51d26244194ba61a5a548a61e2d5611fc5402391`

Read: card objectui#10843 (body, triage `5859999481`, claim `5860209758`, the os-dev-report `5860603168`), PR objectui#10838, PR objectui#10860 (body, diff, file list, check-runs), `@radix-ui/react-select` 2.3.7, `react-popover` 1.1.23, `react-focus-scope` 1.1.16 (the repo's patch), `react-dismissable-layer` 1.1.19 and `react-use-controllable-state` 1.2.6 at their installed versions, and the tree at the head and at `origin/main` `4aebea00a`. Probes ran in a detached worktree of the head under my scratch dir after an offline `pnpm install`; the shared checkouts were not touched. CI on this head, read at 2026-09-27T23:16Z: 43 check-runs, 40 success, 3 skipped, 0 failed (`Type Check`, `Lint`, `Build & E2E`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` all success).

### ① Derived judgments

**The `onSelect` falsification is true, read at source.** `SelectItem` in `@radix-ui/react-select` 2.3.7 destructures `value`, `disabled` and `textValue` and spreads the rest onto `Primitive.div`; `SelectItemProps extends PrimitiveDivProps` declares no `onSelect`, so the prop type-checks as the DOM `select` event and nothing ever dispatches it. A pick is `handleSelect`, reached from the item's `onPointerUp` (pointer type `mouse`), `onClick` (every other pointer type) and `onKeyDown` (Enter or Space outside a type-ahead). The `@object-ui/components` `SelectItem` wrapper forwards `...props` unchanged, so the hook's handlers reach the item, composed BEFORE Radix's own (`composeEventHandlers` runs the caller's handler first).

**The mechanism is sound on the three item paths it covers, and its timing claims hold.**
- The one-event mark is not timing-dependent. `mark()`, then Radix `handleSelect`, then `context.onOpenChange(false)`, then `useControllableState`'s `setValue`, which for a CONTROLLED prop calls `onChange` synchronously, so the hook's `onOpenChange` reads `activating` still true. That is one synchronous handler; the microtask only has to outlive it, and a slow machine changes nothing. The controlled `open` is load-bearing: uncontrolled, Radix reports the close from a `useEffect`, after the microtask.
- Double activation: a mouse pick marks on `pointerup` and again on the following `click`; the second finds the select already closed (controlled prop already `false`, so no callback). Enter auto-repeat is the same. A type-ahead inside the OPEN list moves focus on a timer and changes no value; the space that follows is swallowed by Radix (`isTypingAhead && key === ' '`) while the hook's mark dies in the microtask (pinned; ablation 1 below).
- `onCloseAutoFocus` with the return cancelled: measured, focus lands on the calendar's first tabbable (`button{Go to the Previous Month}`) on every pick path, on the select trigger after Escape from the calendar, and stays on an outside target after an outside interaction (`leftOutside`). Escape or an outside click on the select WITHOUT a pick leaves `pickedOnClose` false, so Radix's own return to the trigger is untouched.
- The controlled `open` writes every Radix-initiated transition (trigger, Escape/dismiss, `window` blur/resize) straight back into state; the select/lookup filter's `Select` and the text filter are untouched, and the full `plugin-dashboard` suite is green in CI.
- REASONED, not measured, two edges: (i) `pickedOnClose` is consumed only when the select CONTENT unmounts; a re-open during its exit animation would keep the flag for the next close. Not reachable by mouse (the select's `DismissableLayer` disables body pointer events until unmount) nor by keyboard (focus is inside the exiting content). (ii) Picking 「Custom…」 while the calendar's own exit animation is still running keeps the popover content mounted, so no auto-focus into it and focus falls to body; that needs a sub-150 ms mouse sequence.

**⛔ One pick path is dropped, and it regresses a keyboard interaction that worked on base.** Radix has a THIRD pick path with no item event at all: type-ahead on the CLOSED trigger (`SelectTrigger` `onKeyDown`, then `handleTypeaheadSearch`, then `context.onValueChange(nextItem.value)`). The head removes the `CUSTOM_VALUE` branch from `onValueChange`, so that path is now inert. Measured in Chromium (method below): a preset stored, focus the closed date select, press `c`. Base shows `September 2026|October 2026` at t+0, 50, 150, 300, 600 and 1500 ms with focus on the calendar's nav button; no select content exists on that path, so nothing returns focus, and it was the ONE path that opened and stayed open on base. Head shows nothing at any sample, calls no `onChange`, and the trigger still reads `Last 7 days`. Re-derived in the repo's own harness (happy-dom, user-event, `trigger.focus()` then `user.keyboard('c')`): head `expected [] to deeply equal [ 'September 2026', 'October 2026' ]`, base passes. With a custom range already stored, `c` names the current item, which `findNextItem` excludes, so that side is unchanged. The source comment's model ("a pick is the item's pointer-up, click or Enter/Space key, depending on the input") is therefore incomplete, and the PR body repeats it. Fix: in `DateRangeFilter`'s `onValueChange`, when `v === CUSTOM_VALUE` arrives while the select is CLOSED (`custom.select.open === false`; an in-list pick arrives with it still open, because `handleSelect` calls `onValueChange` before `onOpenChange(false)`), open the popover directly, since there is no select content then and nothing to survive; add a pin for it beside the eight, with the stored-range side as its control; correct the comment and the changeset sentence.

**Accessibility.** Escape from the calendar returns focus to the select trigger, measured in both harnesses. Nothing ARIA is added or removed; the invisible popover trigger (an `aria-hidden` span carrying `aria-haspopup` and `aria-expanded`) and the absence of an `aria-controls` from the select trigger to the calendar dialog are on base unchanged.

**Schema faces.** Nothing newly accepted or refused: the diff is `DashboardFilterBar.tsx`, one pin and one changeset; `@object-ui/components` is untouched; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is green.

**Pins.** Re-run in my worktree with only `DashboardFilterBar.tsx` swapped to the base blob `90eb75f1` (restore proved, blob back to `ceb15f15`): `4 failed | 4 passed (8)`. The failures are the stored-reopen, preset stays-open, keyboard-reopen and Escape-focus cases, each `expected [] to deeply equal [...]`: the calendar never mounts (stored) or is gone by `settle()` (preset). Head: 8 passed. Ablations, each applied by exact-string replacement (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed, restored to `ceb15f15`): drop the microtask gives `1 failed | 7 passed`, only the type-ahead control (`expected [ [ 'March 2020', 'April 2020' ] ] to deeply equal []`); open in `onOpenChange` instead of `onCloseAutoFocus` gives `4 failed | 4 passed`, the reopen, stays-open, keyboard and focus cases; drop the focus return gives `1 failed | 7 passed`, only the Escape-focus case (focus on `body`, not the trigger button). Each hits exactly its own case, as claimed. The "harness control" is honest: it is labelled as such, reads only the MutationObserver record, its own comment says "however long it then stays", and it is green on base because the calendar mounts for one render before the select's focus return removes it.

**Real-browser claim, re-measured.** Chromium 1194 from `/opt/pw-browsers`, by the dev's method: a throwaway entry in `apps/console` mounting `DashboardFilterBar` from source with a stateful host, served by the console config with only the bare `react-map-gl` dropped from `optimizeDeps.include`, sampled at t+0, 50, 150, 300, 600 and 1500 ms after the pick. Head: preset to 「Custom…」 by mouse and by keyboard (Enter, End, Enter) reads `September 2026|October 2026` at every sample with focus in the calendar; stored to 「Custom…」 by mouse and by keyboard (Enter, Enter) reads `March 2020|April 2020` at every sample; Escape then leaves focus on `button[combobox]{Date range}`. Base: preset by mouse mounts and is removed 70 ms later with focus back on the trigger (the dev read about 80 ms); preset by keyboard mounts, changes once and is removed; stored never mounts by either input. The dev's table holds.

**`Clause-②: no` is honest.** No schema, acceptance set or public face moves.

### ② Semver level

`patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` is right: a bug fix, no exported face moves, and the package sits in the `fixed` group. Every changeset sentence is true as written (both defects measured in Chromium, the reopen on the first day's month, Escape returning focus to the date select, Escape or an outside click on the select opening nothing, a preset still committing). It is silent on the closed-trigger type-ahead path, so the CHANGELOG would read as if nothing was lost; once that path is restored, the sentence "opens the calendar from its own activation (pointer, touch, Enter or Space)" should name it too.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Falsification 1 (the item's own `onSelect`): true at source**, see ①. **Falsification 2 (the preset path as a green control): true**, re-measured on base above. The taken route is the item's own activation events, which is the brief's first option with the right event names, and execution note 2 (a stored range, then 「Custom…」 shows the stored `from` month; preset to 「Custom…」 as the control) is met. Declining the 「Edit range」 trigger is right: it would not satisfy note 2 and adds visible text in every locale.
- **Out-of-scope 1 (console dev server): reproduced verbatim** in my worktree on the unmodified config at the head. `pnpm exec vite --port N --strictPort` in `apps/console` exits 1 with `"." is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "development", "import"] from package .../react-map-gl`; the installed 8.1.2 exports `./mapbox`, `./maplibre` and `./mapbox-legacy` only; a wrapper that drops the bare entry starts. `Build & E2E` is green because `vite build` never reads `optimizeDeps.include`. It blocks the documented local dev door (AGENTS.md 「Local dev」) and the `verify` skill's preview gallery, so it is a card for the seat, not an acceptance note.
- **Out-of-scope 2 (`onSelect` type-checks and never fires): true**, `SelectItemProps extends PrimitiveDivProps`.
- **PR body.** The blob claims hold (`4d0b53954` and `2abda2ccc` both carry `f92b91cf`; the last commit changes comment lines and one changeset sentence only). One sentence is false by omission: "a pick is `handleSelect`, called from the item's `onPointerUp` (mouse), `onClick` (touch and pen) and `onKeyDown` (Enter or Space)". The closed trigger's type-ahead also picks, through `context.onValueChange` and no item event, and the negative control "type-ahead `c` then space" covers the OPEN list only.
- **Pending changesets naming `DashboardFilterBar.tsx`** (`10132-dashboard-i18n-declared-not-resolved`, `10722-date-fns-display-locale`, `5458-unprefixed-query-params`): their sentences are about `translateOptions` through `object`, the `Calendar` this file mounts reading the display locale, and `$select` and `$top` on the fallback `find`, all code this diff leaves untouched. None is made false.
